ai.zuoyanmod.gui.title: AI Configuration
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.enabled.desc: Off leaves only /ai status and help, and the chat prefix stops triggering. Useful to pause AI without deleting the config.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.provider.desc: Model protocol to speak: openai-compatible (OpenAI/DeepSeek/Qwen) or anthropic (Claude Messages API).
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.baseUrl.desc: API root without /chat/completions; a trailing slash is stripped automatically.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.model.desc: Model name, e.g. deepseek-chat or gpt-4o-mini. Empty means /ai chat will ask you to configure it first.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.temperature.de: Sampling temperature. Lower is steadier, higher is more creative; 0.2-0.7 works well for Q&A.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.maxTokens.desc: Upper bound on one reply. Too small truncates the answer, too large costs more per call.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.chatPrefixEnab: Whether to intercept player chat. Off by default: you pay for the key, so intercepting everything costs money and sends chat to a third party.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.chatPrefix.des: Only messages starting with this prefix reach the AI. Works together with the toggle above.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.toolCallingEna: Let the model call read-only lookup tools (blocks, entities, containers). More accurate, but one question may be billed several times.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.tool.container: Let the container search read item contents. Item names are then sent to your third-party API — please be aware on public servers.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.tool.adminLeve: Minimum level for admin tools; below it they are hidden from the model.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.tool.dangerous: Let AI propose commands (default off). /ai confirm runs them as you; not undoable.
Let AI propose builds (off by default). You confirm with /ai confirm; undoable.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.build.maxBlock: Volume cap per build, air included.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.build.blocksPe: Blocks placed per tick. Higher builds faster but costs more TPS.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.timeoutSeconds: HTTP timeout per request, in seconds. Raise it on slow networks; long waits look like a hang to players.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.retryCount.des: Retries on failure. Only network errors and 5xx are retried; 4xx is not (retrying never helps there).
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.replyChunkSize: Characters per reply page. One Minecraft chat line is length-limited, so long answers must be split.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.replyIntervalT: Delay between pages in game ticks (20 ticks = 1s), so a reply does not flood the chat.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.requestCooldow: Minimum gap in seconds between two requests from the same player, to stop click-spamming.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.maxConcurrentR: How many LLM requests may be in flight server-wide. Higher serves more players and uses more bandwidth.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.toolMaxSteps.d: Max LLM round-trips per message — the worst-case number of billed calls for one question.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.toolMaxResults: Max results returned by one tool call, so a whole region of blocks cannot flood the context.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.toolMaxScanBlo: Work budget for the block search, counted in scanned block positions. Tools run synchronously on the server thread and cannot be interrupted, so the work itself is capped.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.toolLoopTimeou: Wall-clock budget in seconds for the whole tool loop. After this it stops calling the model and wraps up.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.context.entity: Scan radius in blocks for nearby entities in the context. Larger covers more and is slower to collect.
How many nearby entities to list (sorted by distance).
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.context.contai: Scan radius in blocks for nearby containers (chests, barrels...).
How many nearby containers to list (sorted by distance).
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.context.struct: Look up the nearest village. Lets the AI answer village coordinates, but the query shares code with /locate and is not cheap.
Village search radius in chunks. Vanilla /locate defaults to 100; this is more conservative.
How long in seconds each player's village lookup is cached. 0 disables caching.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.context.invent: How many inventory summary entries to list, aggregated by item.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.history.maxMes: Max retained history messages per player; the oldest are dropped first.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.history.maxCha: Max retained history characters per player, so context and cost cannot grow forever.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.field.ai.permission.adm: Minimum permission level allowed to edit AI settings and use /ai admin commands: 0 all, 1 moderators, 2 op, 3 admins, 4 owners.
ai.zuoyanmod.gui.api_key_desc: Leave empty to keep the current key; typing replaces it. Write-only and never echoed — use /ai key clear to remove it.

ai.zuoyanmod.help.goal: §e/ai goal set|show|clear <goal> §7- set/show/clear your current goal (steers what the AI looks up first)
ai.zuoyanmod.help.keybind: §ePress O §7- open the AI configuration screen (administrator permission required to change)
ai.zuoyanmod.help.provider: §e/ai provider <id> §7- switch provider: mock / openai-compatible / ollama (administrator permission)
ai.zuoyanmod.help.baseurl: §e/ai baseurl <url> §7- change the API base URL and persist it (administrator permission)
ai.zuoyanmod.help.model: §e/ai model <name> §7- change the default model and persist it (administrator permission)
ai.zuoyanmod.help.key: §e/ai key set|clear <key> §7- set/clear the API key (administrator permission; env var is preferred)
ai.zuoyanmod.help.debug: §e/ai debug context §7- print the context that would be sent to the AI (administrator permission)
ai.zuoyanmod.help.reload: §e/ai reload §7- reload configuration and key (administrator permission)
